The '''''Sinking Stone''''' was a stolen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessel. It was used by [[Soron Hegerty]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a mobile base for her attempts to help the [[Ssither]] of [[Jatee]].<ref name="EJ" />
